##### There are some shortcuts available.
- 1) Ctrl+c and Ctrl+v for normal copy and paste of texts
- 2) Ctrl and hover over the blocks you want to select, Ctrl+shift and hover to deselect the blocks 
- 3) Ctrl+y to copy the selected blocks ,and Ctrl+p to paste the copied blocked below the selected block
- 4) Ctrl + 1 for getting paragraph ++p --p when you start editing a new block, likewise, Ctrl+2 for list and Ctrl+3 for table
